summary: SNDL Inc. filed its interim unaudited financial statements for Q2 2026 via Form 6-K. The filing contains only routine quarterly reports (balance sheet, income statement, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications under Canadian Reg 52-109F2). No extraordinary corporate events or special-situations triggers were announced. The financials show net revenue of C$235.8M for Q2 2026 and C$431.7M for H1 2026, with operating losses. No M&A, activist, restructuring, rights offering, or any other special-situation category is present. The filing is a standard periodic report.
